title: Cosmic Ladybug Entity
description: A massive surreal ladybug-like creature with a single large red eye and two smaller white eyes stands in shallow water. Floating white letter tiles spelling variations of '0', '1', 'L', 'O', 'R', 'D', 'E' drift around it against a dramatic twilight sky with swirling clouds and distant mountains.
prompt: A giant surreal monstrous ladybug creature with a glossy red shell covered in white spots, a huge central glowing red eye, and two smaller white eyes stands in a shallow reflective pool of water in a misty field. Its body is dark and spiky with purple glowing elements. White floating tiles with letters O R D L E 1 0 drift around it. Dramatic twilight sky with swirling clouds, stars, and distant mountains in the background, painted in a dark fantasy style with visible brush strokes.
